verdict.rationale: GlitchTip has no dedicated sandbox or test mode. It does document its own data-isolation mechanisms: separate projects for staging versus production instances, as many organizations as needed, and a self-hostable Docker deployment that can run as an isolated instance. A CLI `send-event` command lets you verify a setup with test events, and environment tagging (`--env`, environment filters) separates data within a project. missing for 10: a first-party sandbox/test-mode environment, documented guidance on keeping test traffic from reaching production data, a way for agents (MCP/CLI) to target a sandbox explicitly, and independent corroboration.
